audience: store owners and ops teams that sell through Snipcart on their own website

useCases.title: Review orders and their refunds
useCases.text: List the completed orders, filtered by status or payment status. Open one order, then list the refunds issued on it.

useCases.title: Find the best-selling products
useCases.text: List products sorted by sales count, sales value or creation date. Get one product by its id for its details.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their orders
useCases.text: Find customers by status, exact e-mail address or name. Then list the orders that one customer placed.

useCases.title: Review abandoned carts
useCases.text: List the carts that were started but not paid, by how long ago they were abandoned. Open one cart to see what was in it.

useCases.title: Check discount codes
useCases.text: List the discount codes of the store, then get one code by its id.

useCases.title: Review recurring subscriptions
useCases.text: List the recurring subscriptions, filtered by status. Open one subscription to see its details.
